name: Feature Delivery
description: Plan-before-code software delivery with explicit verification and repository-context review.

tasks.name: Lock feature contract
tasks.objective: Translate the request into user-visible behavior, constraints, non-goals, compatibility requirements, acceptance criteria, migration concerns, and evidence required to call it done.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Acceptance criteria test observable behavior rather than implementation trivia.

tasks.name: Reconnaissance
tasks.objective: Trace relevant entry points, callers, data models, tests, configuration, build rules, analogous code, and operational constraints. Identify hidden coupling and the smallest coherent change surface before planning edits.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The plan names actual symbols/files and their callers, not guessed architecture.

tasks.name: Design verification before code
tasks.objective: Define behavioral tests, invariants, regression cases, failure paths, compatibility checks, build/lint/static gates, and an external integration proof that would fail if the feature were missing or unwired.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Verification distinguishes a real implementation from a plausible stub.

tasks.name: Implement bounded change
tasks.objective: Implement the smallest coherent change satisfying the contract. Preserve existing behavior outside scope, reuse authoritative abstractions, avoid duplicate sources of truth, and keep risky side effects behind existing approval/security boundaries.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every changed component maps to a requirement, integration need, or verification need.

tasks.name: Run verification gates
tasks.objective: Run relevant tests, native/build checks, type/lint/static analysis, and focused integration exercise. Record exact commands and results; a green subset is not a green repository.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Completion evidence identifies which gates actually ran and which did not.

tasks.name: Repository-context review
tasks.objective: Review the diff in repository context: inspect callers, contracts, side effects, failure paths, concurrency/lifetime, migrations, tests, docs, security boundaries, and whether the feature is actually wired to a reachable caller.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Findings are concrete and traceable to code paths or missing evidence.
A feature with no caller is treated as incomplete.

tasks.name: Prove integration
tasks.objective: Apply review fixes, rerun affected gates, inspect final diff, verify requested behavior from an external entry point, and package the change with limitations and rollback/migration notes where relevant.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The requested behavior is reachable through its intended integration path.
Final evidence matches the exact committed change.
